entities.summary:
Lőrinc Orczy was a Hungarian nobleman, general and poet, born on August 9, 1718, in Tarnaörs, and died on July 28, 1789.



Orczy was a key figure in the development of Hungarian military strategy during the 18th century, serving as a general in the Ottoman-Hungarian War. He also made significant contributions to Hungarian literature, publishing several works of poetry and prose.



Despite his notable achievements, Orczy's legacy has been somewhat overshadowed by that of his contemporaries, and he is largely remembered today as a minor figure in Hungarian history.



In recent years, however, Orczy's life and work have gained renewed interest among historians and scholars, who are working to shed new light on his significance and impact on Hungarian society.
